synthesis: Add a gated Scout provisioning section to the Clarity Create/Edit User form so an org admin can make a user a functional Scout user without going to the Kit-centric Scout Users screen. Per Dalton's gate decisions: (1) mechanism = directly toggle the `clarity-scout` Spatie PERMISSION (no new role); (2) scope = permission + Kit assignment + onboarding email (zones/vehicle-type/force-login stay in Scout Users); (3) gating = only visible for Scout-enabled orgs (Feature::active(CLARITY_SCOUT) || admin_impersonator) to admins, matching ScoutUsersResource::canAccess(). The canonical provisioning mechanics live in ScoutUsersResource + EditScoutUser: setPermissionsTeamId($orgId) then givePermissionTo/revokePermissionTo('clarity-scout'); on grant of an unverified user, notify(new ScoutOnboardingNotification); Kit tie via KitSettings::updateOrCreate(['kit_id'=>...],['user_id'=>...]) with 1:1 enforcement (detach the user from any other kit). The Users form is user-centric (inverse of the kit-centric Scout Users), so it needs a Kit picker offering kits not already assigned to another user.

scope.summary: Add a gated 'Scout' section to UsersResource Create/Edit forms with a Scout Access toggle (grant/revoke clarity-scout) and an available-Kit picker; on save, reconcile the permission, tie/untie the Kit via KitSettings (1:1), and send ScoutOnboardingNotification on first grant to an unverified user. Visible only for Scout-enabled orgs to admins. Reuse the exact grant/kit/onboarding mechanics from EditScoutUser (prefer extracting a shared helper over duplicating).

proposed_changes.change: Add a Scout section (Toggle 'web_access_enabled'/Scout Access + Select kit picker of unassigned kits) gated by a ->visible()/canAccess-style check on Feature::active(CLARITY_SCOUT) || admin_impersonator AND admin. Fields are virtual (not User columns) — dehydrate and handle in page hooks. Also surface Scout state in the table (a Scout Access icon column) for AC3.

After create: if Scout section present + toggle on, setPermissionsTeamId(org), givePermissionTo('clarity-scout'), assign RoleEnum::USER if roleless, tie the chosen Kit via KitSettings (detach from other kits), notify(new ScoutOnboardingNotification) when unverified.

On save: reconcile Scout Access (grant if newly on + onboarding when unverified; revoke if newly off), and reconcile the Kit assignment (updateOrCreate/clear KitSettings, 1:1). Mirror EditScoutUser's had/has logic.
Extract grant+kit+onboarding into a shared method (e.g. an action on User or a Concern) so UsersResource pages and EditScoutUser don't drift. Plan-arbiter decides whether to extract now or inline.
proposed_changes.reason: avoid duplicating the landmine-prone permission/onboarding logic

proposed_changes.change: Pinning tests: Scout section visible only for Scout orgs+admin; create with Scout on grants clarity-scout + ties kit + queues onboarding; edit add/remove flips permission + kit; existing (non-Scout) create/edit flows stay green; non-Scout org hides the section.

out_of_scope: Zones map, vehicle type, and force-login on the Users form (stay in Scout Users).
Editing vendor/insight-lpr/black-adam RoleEnum (no Scout role is being created).
Changing ScoutUsersResource's own workflow or CLARITY_SCOUT gating semantics.
Any new role/permission seeding or migration — clarity-scout permission already exists and is seeded.

acceptance_criteria.reason: Scout Access toggle in a gated section.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC2: Scout selectable independently or combined with other roles
acceptance_criteria.reason: Independent toggle; permission is orthogonal to the roles CheckboxList.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC3: Scout persists on save + reflected in user management views
acceptance_criteria.reason: Permission + kit persisted; add a Scout Access column to the Users table.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC4: Existing users can have Scout added/removed via edit
acceptance_criteria.reason: EditUsers reconciles grant/revoke + kit; direct-permission mechanism makes revoke reliable.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC5: No regression to existing role options or user creation flow
acceptance_criteria.reason: Additive gated section; existing UsersResourceTest stays green; non-Scout orgs see no change.

questions.q: MECHANISM: real Scout Role vs. toggle the clarity-scout permission?
questions.answer: Toggle the clarity-scout PERMISSION directly (givePermissionTo/revokePermissionTo). No Spatie role. Avoids the revoke landmine.

questions.q: WORKFLOW: same as Scout Users or different; what does the Users form do?
questions.answer: Full provisioning on the Users form BUT bounded to permission + Kit assignment + onboarding email. Zones/vehicle-type/force-login stay in Scout Users.

questions.q: GATING: Scout-enabled orgs only or all orgs?
questions.answer: Gate to Scout-enabled orgs (Feature::active(CLARITY_SCOUT) || admin_impersonator), admins only — matching ScoutUsersResource::canAccess().
N/A — resolved by choosing the direct-permission mechanism (Q1); no role inheritance, so ScoutUsersResource's revokePermissionTo stays correct.

questions.q: PROD ROLLOUT: new role/permission seeding to existing orgs?
questions.answer: N/A — no new role/permission. The clarity-scout permission already exists and is seeded; nothing to migrate.

notes: Provisioning mechanics to reuse (EditScoutUser.php): setPermissionsTeamId($orgId) is REQUIRED before permission grant/check (teams-based Spatie); assignRole(RoleEnum::USER) if roleless; givePermissionTo('clarity-scout'); notify(new ScoutOnboardingNotification) only when !email_verified_at; KitSettings::updateOrCreate(['kit_id'=>..],['user_id'=>..]) with 1:1 enforcement (detach user from other kits).
Available-kit picker: mirror ScoutUsersResource assigned_user_id logic inverted — offer kits whose KitSettings.user_id is null (or the user's current kit).
Scout users get RoleEnum::USER (Default User) + clarity-scout permission — the permission, not a role, is what gates Scout everywhere.
The ticket's DEV-1772 'checkbox precedent' is false; DEV-1772 built the separate ScoutUsersResource.

Grep backstop confirmed clarity-scout write sites: ScoutUsersResource(:446/:459) + EditScoutUser(:75/:112/:118); consumers ClarityScoutAuthController/ScoutSetPasswordController/ClarityScoutMiddleware/ClientMiddleware/UserMiddleware. New Users-form write sites must use the same setPermissionsTeamId + direct grant/revoke.

tests.what_it_pins: Create/edit role flows stay green (AC5) + new Scout create/edit/remove/gating cases (AC1-AC4).
Existing grant/revoke clarity-scout stays correct; a user granted via the Users form is still revocable from Scout Users.

grounding.code_flow: UsersResource form gains a gated Scout section (toggle + kit Select). CreateUsers/EditUsers page hooks reconcile: setPermissionsTeamId(org) -> give/revoke clarity-scout -> assignRole(USER) if roleless -> KitSettings::updateOrCreate (1:1 detach) -> ScoutOnboardingNotification when granting to an unverified user. Consumers of clarity-scout unchanged. Gating mirrors ScoutUsersResource::canAccess().

plan_sketch.intent: For a Scout-enabled org admin, Create User shows the Scout section (toggle + kit picker); a non-Scout org does not.
Enable Scout with a kit + also pick a regular role; both persist independently.
Create Scout user; Edit form + Users list Scout column reflect it; KitSettings.user_id set.
Add then remove Scout on an existing user via Edit; verify hasPermissionTo('clarity-scout') flips and kit ties/unties; onboarding email queued once.
Existing UsersResourceTest green; non-Scout create/edit unaffected; Scout Users still works for a user provisioned here.

qa_hint.seed_scenario: One org with CLARITY_SCOUT enabled (admin + a couple of Kits with no assigned user, one unverified target user) and one org without CLARITY_SCOUT (admin). Exercise create+edit on both.
